entrypoints.contract: Native serialized data only; load_request accepts native str/bytes and returns bounded decoded tree. evaluate_request accepts bounded closed v3 envelope and returns complete wire response. Malformed transport/envelope raises ReferenceWireReject; unexpected implementation errors escape.

Native integer seeds 0..1023 only, bool rejected. case object has seed,family,partition,expected_status,request,hash_wire,activation_permission. iter_cases yields that same closed domain in ascending order; no oracle or target imported.

historical_artifacts: Preserved outside this exact export; no e6/v2/061 source or legacy program dependency included
import_context: The three Python modules share one tests directory; names are ordinary module names, with no package or runtime dependency on legacy files
manual_dependency: Only the new v3/manual-slices.json is read; its bytes are copied from frozen e6 data, never imported from an old program
pinning: Source commit C contains the ten non-manifest artifacts. Follow-up manifest-only commit F pins all ten C blobs; pin F by its immutable Git commit, with no circular self hash.
root_bridge_input: Only this interface, the full wire contract and public rule data are needed for a root-owned bridge. Do not use reference arithmetic or expected-program source to implement target-side logic.
